verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a voice-agent framework, so voice cloning with a consent process is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions voice cloning, custom brand voices, or any consent workflow. Swapping among 200+ integrated providers is a general integration feature, not a documented cloning-and-consent capability of Pipecat itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can clone a custom brand voice and use it for my agents, with a documented consent process
